Description: Which StudyLife server should this app connect to?
UnexpectedResponse: Server responded, but unexpectedly (HTTP {0}). Tap again to use it anyway.
ServerUnreachable: Server unreachable. Tap again to use the URL anyway.
Intro: StudyLife is self-hosted: there is no central service. To use the app you need the address of your own StudyLife server, or of the one your school, university or organisation runs.
SetupGuideLink: How to set up your own server
EmptyUrl: Enter the address of your StudyLife server first.
NotStudyLifeServer: That address answers, but it does not look like a StudyLife server. Check it, or tap again to use it anyway.
